summary: Four UI tests (no-project, initial-loading via FIFO gate, clean-tree, git-failure) each assert a state-specific, mutually-exclusive text and assert absence of the 'Files' stat card, which only renders in the populated-summary branch of DiffPaneView; states are exclusive if/else branches in DiffModel/DiffPaneView so the counterexample of a state leaking into a populated summary is genuinely rejected.
